answer: Each new identity must lock a bond that thaws like a glacier: 40 tokens released over 8 epochs, with slashing if linked. A 50-clone farm needs 50 x 40 = 2,000 tokens frozen for 8 epochs, and any single caught vertex of the clone graph forfeits all bonds jointly. A bridge of decoy tasks priced at 5 tokens each adds 50 x 5 = 250 per round.
